original_language: English Warhammer Age of Sigmar terminology
definition: The Fourth Edition Core Book’s setting context, described in official launch material through its locales, cultures, history, and entwined cosmology.
cultural_caution: A fictional setting-cosmology term, not a character endpoint, a real belief claim, or a statement that all Warhammer worlds share this cosmology.

citations.locator: Official Core Book description, first paragraph
supports: Mortal Realms as the selected Fourth Edition Core Book setting context.

original_language: English Warhammer Age of Sigmar terminology
definition: The Core Book’s setting presentation is described by Games Workshop as exploring each of the eight realms from inhabitants’ perspectives.
cultural_caution: A bounded Core Book cosmology description, not a complete cross-edition cosmological model or an individual/collective character node.

supports: The Fourth Edition Core Book’s eight-realm exploration.

original_language: English Warhammer Age of Sigmar rules terminology
definition: The foundational Fourth Edition rules component distributed in the official 2024 rules rollout.
cultural_caution: A tabletop rules component, not a setting entity, character endpoint, or an assertion that pre-Fourth-Edition rules remain current.

supports: Core Rules as a Fourth Edition rules-document component.

original_language: English Warhammer Age of Sigmar rules terminology
definition: The additional Fourth Edition rules component listed with the Core Rules in the official launch rollout.
cultural_caution: A tabletop rules component, not a narrative caste, a character endpoint, or an inference about a player’s skill level.

supports: Advanced Rules as a selected Fourth Edition rules component.

original_language: English Warhammer Age of Sigmar rules terminology
definition: A Fourth Edition game mode with rules included in the official 2024 rules rollout.
cultural_caution: A game-mode term, not a faction, a military-historical claim, or evidence that a named miniature has a narrative role.

supports: Spearhead Rules as a selected Fourth Edition game-mode component.

original_language: English Warhammer Age of Sigmar rules terminology
definition: The Path to Glory battlepack identified by official Fourth Edition Core Book launch material.
cultural_caution: A tabletop narrative-play structure, not an in-world character transformation or a claim about a named figure’s rise to power.
